jet_list.title: F-35I
jet_list.desc: The most advanced stealth fighter in the world, able to strike unseen deep behind enemy lines.

notes.drag_chute: no F-16 or F-35 has a drag chute: the flight never asks the flight model for one
notes.sixdof: Physics Flight model on 6-DoF: Modern IAF's 6-DoF from its own data (modern-iaf/docs/flight-model.md §9; docs/deviations.md §2)
notes.radar.km: AN/APG-81, multiple-target track beyond 80 NM (U, docs/f35i.md)
notes.gun_rounds: GAU-22/A 25 mm, 180 rounds (the 20 MM record stands in)
notes.voice.real: the pull-up call only (Auto-GCAS lineage, docs/real-betty.md)
notes.voice.real_betty: Extras Real Betty: the F-16 VMS set, as Modern IAF takes it (the F-35I's own list is open, docs/real-betty.md)
notes.engine_spool: F135-PW-100: flight idle -> maximum power about 6 s (Pratt & Whitney); the split inferred (docs/flight-model.md §10.2)
notes.goggles: the helmet's night camera, drawn as the late Gen III; its cockpit lit for it (docs/rendering.md §8.3)
